notes.title: 🐸 Frog Galaxy Survivor is Back!
notes.notes:
[p]🐸 Hello, friends![/p][p]You may remember that the original developer, Hunt Games, was forced to pause work on Frog Galaxy Survivor due to difficulties and the large amount of work ahead. This was truly sad news, as the game had already won the hearts of many players with its engaging gameplay and vibrant style. It would be a real shame to leave such a promising project unfinished.[/p][p]💥 That’s why we, the team at Whale Rock Games, decided to give Frog Galaxy Survivor another chance! We’re excited to continue development and bring the game all the way to a full release. Here’s what we have planned:[/p][p]🎮 Completely rework the gameplay foundation, turning it into a truly captivating vampire survivor-like[/p][p]🌌 Add new locations with unique enemies and mechanics[/p][p]🔫 Expand Frogus’s arsenal — expect even more powerful and stylish weapons[/p][p]🎯 Refresh the interface — modern, user-friendly, and pleasing to the eye[/p][p]🛠 Fix bugs and implement many other improvements[/p][p]We’d also love to hear your thoughts: what do you think about the current version of the game, and what do you feel it’s missing? Your feedback will help us shape the game into exactly what you want it to be.[/p][p]Thank you for staying with us. Frog Galaxy Survivor is coming back — and this is just the beginning of its journey![/p][p]🚀 With love,[/p][p]The Whale Rock Games Team

notes.title: We’re excited to announce a major update!
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!
We've been working hard to improve the game, and we're excited to announce a major update that includes:
•	New levels and the story finale – Discover how the protagonist’s journey ends.
•	New type of enemies – Now opponents are armed with firearms.
•	Revamped main menu – Stylish, user-friendly, and atmospheric.
•	Rewritten dialogues.
•	Reworked locations.
•	Terminal puzzles.
•	Numerous bug fixes and many other improvements!
But that's not all — we’re not stopping here! In the upcoming builds, you can look forward to:
•	Enhanced combat system – Battles will become even more dynamic and spectacular.
•	Advanced enemy AI – Enemies will be more aggressive and dangerous.
•	Rage mechanic.
•	New abilities.
•	More puzzles.
Stay tuned, share your feedback, and don't miss the upcoming updates!

notes.title: The Global Update
notes.notes:
We welcome everyone!

We decided to listen to your comments and release a global update that fixes a number of aspects:

Firstly, we have redesigned the board control system at the 6th and 14th locations. Now you have to drive a gravity car with good control.

We also removed a number of unnecessary cutscenes (camera spans) on the 2nd level.

Finally, the dialogue system has been fixed. Now extra buttons with empty answer options are not displayed.

notes.title: About the recent chapter
notes.notes:
The experiment with this chapter is that both of its locations will be presented in the first person - to emphasize the emotional importance of this part of the story for the protagonist. Two years ago, he had a different life, but after some events, his former life ended. And he refers to a new life to a certain extent detached - from the third person, as in the main time of the game. This is typical for his actions in the real world and in the worlds of fantasy MMOs, where the game character of our hero meets the character of the Customer to agree on the details of the deals. Thus, reality and the game are presented from the third person, demonstrating the "equidistance" of what is happening in both worlds from the main character, and to some extent his indifference.

In the further development of the plot, it is also planned to change the species at key moments, indicating their personal importance, and often the shock states of the protagonist. Making it clear that at the moments of making important decisions, he becomes himself, partly returning his old life.
Yes, and in the new chapter we will know the name of the protagonist for the first time... We will do without spoilers now, but believe me, everything was conceived so as to look impressive. Ideally, the name should speak for itself, tell its own story, and we aimed at such a result.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134973/334604305444ca4a38359d27707f39e364798bb1.png[/img]

notes.title: New chapter - unique solutions
notes.notes:
Early Access is always, to some extent, an experiment.

By running [b]The Divine Invasion [/b] as a third-person game (mainly to implement beautiful and dynamic sword fights), we found that the logic of the plot development requires giving the main character more personality.

In many ways, it is for this purpose that we have developed a new chapter, revealing the backstory of the protagonist. The chapter is intended to show who he was before the events of the game, and hint who he will become. However, some things are obvious... for a real hero, the choice is small: do what you must, and come what may.

So it's time to purchase [b]The Divine Invasion[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134973/cd95a3ed066fd2622082412256b6b4ba164d6176.png[/img]

notes.title: Hard science fiction
notes.notes:
If we remember the history of John Shepard (Mass Effect) or Adam Jensen (Deus Ex), then we will see the structure of the chivalric romance. In the heart of the undetectable knight in shining armor of the future, in the fight against sci-Fi dragons and sometimes against the futuristic windmills (cosplay don Quixote), for the world or for the heart of a lady. Similar story is considered a classic, and despite this, is relevant for any time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38134973/04a56dfc01ee95124dcf01c51af1a669855203b8.png[/img]

[b]The Divine Invasion[/b] to a certain extent follows the structure of tales of chivalry. However, the action takes place not in the middle ages, and roughly in the year 2084. In the world of cyberpunk, which is conceptually similar to the Noir of the future depicted in the movie "blade Runner" 1982
